name: Tutorial Writing
description: Creates learning-oriented tutorials with clear objectives, prerequisite knowledge, step-by-step instructions, explanations of why each step matters, and exercises for reinforcement. Use when the user needs to teach someone how to learn a skill or technology through guided practice. Do NOT use for task documentation (use `user-guide`), how-to articles (use `how-to-guide`), or API references (use `api-documentation`).
